text: Geological engineering is an applied discipline that is based on geology and integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as engineering, mechanics, and materials science to solve engineering problems related to the geological environment. It focuses on the interaction between the geological structure on the Earth's surface and interior and engineering construction. The core lies in ensuring the safety of engineering, rational utilization of geological resources, and prevention of geological disasters through geological exploration, analysis, and technical means. From large-scale infrastructure projects (such as bridges and tunnels) to geological disaster prevention (such as landslides and earthquakes), and to engineering design in resource development, geological engineering plays a crucial role.
